result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the tags feature for posts. Here's a summary of what was changed:

## Changes Made

### Database & Schema
- Added `tags` table with `id` and `name` columns (name is unique)
- Added `post_tags` pivot table linking posts and tags
- Created migration `20260925121100_add_tags`

### Backend Models
- Updated `Post` model to include `belongsToMany` relationship with tags
- Created new `Tag` model with corresponding relationship

### Validation & Form Handling
- Updated `PostPayloadSchema` to include `tags` field validation:
  - Accepts comma-separated string input
  - Trims whitespace and filters empty entries
  - Enforces 1-30 character tag names
  - Limits to maximum 5 tags per post
  - Deduplicates tags (case-sensitive)

### Controller Logic
- `PostController.index()`: Filters posts by tag when `?tag=` parameter is provided
- `PostController.store()`: Creates tags and attaches them to new posts
- `PostController.update()`: Syncs tags (deletes old, adds new) when post is updated
- `PostController.show()` and `edit()`: Load tags relation for display and editing

### Frontend Components
- **New.tsx & Edit.tsx**: Added "Tags" input field with placeholder "e.g. bun, webdev"
- **Edit.tsx**: Pre-fills tags field from existing post data (joins array to string)
- **Index.tsx & Show.tsx**: Displays tags as clickable links that filter the post list
- **Pagination**: Tag filters are preserved in pagination links

### Features Implemented
✅ Authors can add comma-separated tags when creating/editing posts  
✅ Tags appear on post list and individual post pages  
✅ Clicking a tag filters posts to show only those with that tag  
✅ Validation rejects invalid input (empty title style errors)  
✅ Tag names are case-sensitive, 1-30 characters  
✅ Maximum 5 tags per post  
✅ Duplicates automatically deduplicated  
✅ All tests pass, typecheck passes
